queries_run: Marriott International product substitute technology threat 2026
Lodging alternative technology disruption AI agents booking hotels 2026 2027

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子載明：若訂房偏好由自有數位通路移向網路旅遊中介，將推高訂房成本並損及獲利；搜尋引擎也可能把業務導離自有通路。
findings.excerpt: Internet search engines may also divert business away from our direct digital channels to intermediaries.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明公司正進行訂房、物業管理與忠誠度系統的多年轉型，部署可能有延遲、系統中斷或資安影響；且若技術更新不如競爭對手快，競爭地位可能受損。
findings.excerpt: We are undertaking a multi-year transformation of our reservations, property management, and loyalty systems. The development and deployment of our new systems could involve delays, system interruptions, compromises of data security, or other operational impacts, including impacts on our financial reporting or internal control environment.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅得第三方預測性評論（AI 代理訂房、Mews 2035 展望、Morgan Stanley 認為對 OTA 的衝擊可能被高估），未讀到頁面原文，未列為 finding；未找到可取代住宿核心產品的替代技術之直接證據。

clues.claim: Mews 預期 2035 年前多數飯店搜尋與訂房將透過單一 AI 對話進行（產業預測，非實測）。
Morgan Stanley 分析認為 agentic AI 對訂房平台的衝擊疑慮可能被高估。
